snippet.title: Sengodai - Official Reveal Trailer | Tsunoa Games
snippet.description:
Sengodai is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you collect and create your Gokai monsters team to explore diverse worlds and challenge the cursed gods.

Website: https://sengodai.com
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4090730/Sengodai/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tsunoagames.sengodai

🌍​ Explore an ever-changing world 
Embark on a new journey every time you play! Choose your path, find new Gokai, face unique enemies, uncover powerful spells, and forge your deck to challenge the cursed gods.

🛠️​ Build and evolve your team
Collect Gokai cards, create a unique team, and upgrade them to make powerful synergies with your team leader, an elemental god!

🔥​ Master your god skills
Master different gods with unique skills and playstyle to lead your team to victory using the divine power of your chosen deity.

🍃​ Unleash spells to dominate
Alter the course of the battle with arcane spells! Draw them from your opponents or buy them from an enigmatic merchant.

💧 Control the elements 
Charge your Gokai with elements to purify the lands and reduce your opponent’s life to zero to claim victory.
